title: Binance loses $5.7 billion in largest crypto hack to date
reason: Largest crypto hack to date at the biggest exchange, with a sourced cause for the accompanying bitcoin price slide — clearly market-moving.

sources.summary: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $79,000.

title: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public
reason: AI-discovered denial-of-service flaws in Bitcoin Core, disclosed under a new bug-disclosure policy, is a genuinely novel research result at the site's core intersection of AI and Bitcoin.

sources.summary: Three flaws a language-model scan dug up are the first disclosed under Core’s new rules for bugs that are easy to find.
